evidenced by the recent speech given by the country’s SAC Commander, Min Aung Hlaing. At large, the international community must respond, and this is where the Myanmar Tribunal will play a critical role. As noted by Special Rapporteur on the situation of human rights in Myanmar, Yang Jiechi in the UN’s report, there is increasing concern over the “tendency of the civilian dispensation...to modify, amend or even nullify failures reports of the UN Human Rights Council.” The Tribunal will ensure accountability, particularly in Myanmar, which is still working to put the horror of genocide on trial.
